premises.text: At conferences and crowded venues people miss valuable nearby connections and stare at distant messages instead
premises.evidence_span: stand by the conference bar eating peanuts, wondering who you should talk to next

premises.text: App lists trending nearby venues and shows how you are connected to everyone there
premises.evidence_span: we give you a list of trending venues nearby. All it takes is one click to see how you're connected to everyone in that venue

premises.text: Scours the web, aggregates public profiles, and sorts the room by relevance to you
premises.evidence_span: Sonar scours the web for people at this venue, then aggregates and synthesizes publicly available profile data, and then sorts the room by who's most relevant to you

premises.text: One-click overview of shared interests, friends, and bio for a stranger
premises.evidence_span: With one click, Sonar gives me an instant overview of Fergus and how we're connected

premises.text: Hyper-targeted intro message with social proof to start the conversation in-venue
premises.evidence_span: you're never more than one click away from a hyper-targeted introduction to the person you want to meet

premises.text: Hyperlocal digital self-expression: tell people here that you're here and what you're about
premises.evidence_span: Sonar's laser-focused on giving you a way to tell people here that you're here and this is what you're about

value.text: Uncover hidden connections with people in the same room so meetings aren't left to chance
value.evidence_span: uncovers the hidden connections that you share with everyone else in this room

secondary_value.text: Hyperlocal social CRM that saves time and money
secondary_value.evidence_span: powerful, hyperlocal social CRM tool that is going to save you time and money

causal_links.evidence_span: bottled the thousands of connections that I definitely would have missed
digital local self-expression that you can use to share what you're proud of and what you're looking for
